title: Binary gcd iteration step
statement: For a Boolean list $S$, define one step as follows: if the natural number represented by the second component decoded from $S$ is zero, return $S$; otherwise, return the pair encoding of that second component and the remainder obtained by applying `mod` to the pair encoding of the two decoded components.
caveat: The pair encoding, pair decoder, binary-value function, and `mod` operation are not defined in the supplied context, so the remainder operation cannot be described more precisely.
